reply: Thank you for explaining that you have paid more than $30,000.00 on a $14,000.00 private student loan for a school that no longer exists, and still owe a balance. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing what relief, rate reduction or modified payment options are available, and keep your payment history. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your balance increased by about $20,000.00 during forbearance without an explanation, and that you are concerned about who has accessed your data. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for a breakdown of how the new balance was calculated, including capitalized interest. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your switch to IBR was accepted, but your loans remain in forbearance for months despite your request to end it, delaying PSLF credit. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep your application and the acceptance notice, and send a written request to end the forbearance. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your information was used to co-sign a $15,000.00 student loan you knew nothing about, and that a fraud report has been filed. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team, including the credit inquiry. Please keep the fraud report details, and check your credit reports for other activity you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your dispute and request for documents about your student loan, including the signed promissory note. We understand why you want these records. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep a copy of your request and proof of when it was sent, and dispute any specific inaccurate item with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that student loans were taken out in your name through identity theft, and that you still receive bills after sending the full identity theft packet. We understand your frustration after four months. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep copies of everything you submitted, and ask in writing for the status of your claim. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that every payment on your $7,000.00 student loan is reversed, and that your bank confirms the problem is not on its side. We understand your concern about your credit. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep your bank's confirmation and records of each reversed payment, and ask in writing for another way to pay. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after some of your loans were forgiven, the resulting negative balances have not been applied to your other loans after more than seven months. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the forgiveness notices and statements, and ask in writing for the reallocation and an updated balance for each loan. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you tried for months to reach someone about lowering your payments, and that your account is now in default. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep a record of each attempt to contact your servicer, and ask in writing about options to leave default and lower your payments. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your application to leave SAVE has not been processed, which is keeping you from making PSLF-eligible payments. We understand your frustration with the long hold times. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep a copy of each application and the date sent, and ask in writing for their status. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a financial aid application was submitted in your name for a university you do not attend. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please report the identity theft, keep the inquiry alert and your account records, and check your credit reports for other activity you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you are trying to remove your name from your daughter's loan, and that your calls and messages have gone unanswered. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please send your request in writing, asking for the requirements to be released from the loan, and keep a copy. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your loans were forgiven under PSLF and you were told to expect a $9,100.00 refund, but you have not received it and a new balance has appeared. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the forgiveness notice, and ask in writing for the refund status and an explanation of the new balance. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told you had a disaster forbearance after the hurricane, but the servicer later changed its records. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the written confirmations of your forbearance and any later letters, and ask in writing for the account to be corrected. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your private loan discharge applications were denied three times, even though your school closed and your federal loans were discharged. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for the specific reasons for each decision and whether further review is possible. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received delinquency alerts for a past due amount of only cents, while the phone system and portal showed your account as current. We understand the effect on your credit score. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep screenshots showing the account as current, and dispute the entries with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your private loan school misconduct discharge was denied four times despite extensive evidence and support from a state office. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the evidence and letters you have, and ask in writing for the specific reasons for each decision. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your federal student loan is reported with conflicting statuses, including collection, charge-off and late payments. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute each inconsistent entry with the credit reporting companies, and ask your servicer in writing to confirm the loan's current status. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your qualifying payments stopped even though your employment continued, and that your account was placed in academic deferment although you are not enrolled. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please send a written request for the deferment to be corrected and for your payment count to be reviewed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your monthly payments were miscalculated, your statements were inaccurate, and late fees were charged in error. We understand the stress this has caused. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep your statements and notes of what you were told, and ask in writing for a corrected payment calculation and fee review. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have made 137 qualifying payments, but your employment certifications have not been reviewed in over a year. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep your payment records and copies of each employment form, and ask in writing for the status of your PSLF review. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid what you understood to be your full $60,000.00 balance, and that $1,900.00 in interest then appeared. We understand your confusion. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. A payoff amount includes interest through the payoff date, so please ask in writing for a detailed interest calculation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a 90-day late payment was reported on your loan without any prior notice, and that the loan is now paid in full. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Accurate information can stay on a credit report, but if the entry is wrong, please dispute it with supporting records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that interest is still being charged on your loans after you enrolled in the PAYE plan. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the screenshots you uploaded and your plan enrollment notice, and ask in writing for an explanation of the interest charges on each loan. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your request for the documents supporting a $600.00 past due amount and the late entries on your account. We understand why you want these records. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep a copy of your request, and dispute any entry you believe is inaccurate with the credit reporting companies as well. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your training loan was not fully paid to your school, leaving balances with both, and that a hold was placed on your transcript. We understand how this affects your job search. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for a record of all funds sent to the school, and keep your payment plan records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked for forbearance after your job became part-time and are still waiting for the mailed paperwork. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for the forms to be sent again or by email, and keep confirmation that your payments are suspended. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your private student loans were sold to a new servicer and that you believe the daily interest charged is too high. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for your interest rate, the daily interest calculation and a payment history, and keep your statements. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the response to your earlier complaint used general language and did not address the specific issues you raised. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please list each specific issue again in writing, with the dates and documents that support it, and keep a copy. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you took an $18,000.00 private loan for a program that was misrepresented to you. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep your enrollment documents, the loan agreement and any marketing materials, and ask in writing what options are available. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
